title: NVDA: long a decade-low 19.5x NTM multiple; target $268.93, stop $174.61, add only if late-Oct capex guides clear our base case
call_reason: Published 12-month target $268.93 is 12.6% above the $238.90 close, P(gain) is 0.63 and the conviction rubric reads medium, but the expected excess return barely covers ~38% volatility, so the position stays small and staged.
one_liner: NVDA trades at ~19.5x NTM EPS, a decade low and below AVGO/TSM, with FY28 guided to ~+70% revenue; even after assuming the multiple compresses to 16x we get a $263 research target (12m) and a $268.93 target. The risk is a 2027-28 hyperscaler capex digestion, so we hold 1 share and add only if the Oct 27-30 capex guides and the ~Nov 17-18 Q3 FY27 print confirm demand.

thesis.point: The valuation already prices heavy de-rating: the stock is flat in a year only at ~13.9x Oct-2027 NTM EPS.
thesis.evidence: $238.90 is ~19.5x NTM consensus EPS of $12.00-12.25 (Q3 FY27-Q2 FY28; stockanalysis fwd P/E 19.34x), vs AVGO 20.49x and TSM 20.65x. Consistent Oct-2027 NTM EPS of $17.1 means a flat year needs ~13.9x, a further ~29% de-rating. All five agents assume compression to 16-17x and still reach research targets (12m) of $250-296.

thesis.point: Earnings visibility through FY28 is unusually high and supply-constrained.
thesis.evidence: Q2 FY27 revenue $96.2B (+106% y/y), Data Center $89.0B (+117%), non-GAAP GM 75.0%. The Q3 guide is $108.0B ±2% at 74.0% GM. Management's preliminary FY28 view is ~+70% revenue at 72-73% GM after a 71-72% Q4 trough. $279B of supply and capacity commitments back the ramp.

thesis.point: Customer capex keeps being revised up, and backlogs fund the 2027 ramp.
thesis.evidence: Big-4 2026 capex guides rose from ~$655B to $732.5B during the year, and none was cut. 2027 Big-4 consensus is $934.5B (IO Fund) to $1,029B (S&P), against our base case of $1,080B. Backlogs: MSFT commercial RPO $678B, Google Cloud $513.9B, AWS $496B. Year-ahead consensus drift was +25% to +62% in each of 2024-26.

variant_view: There is no strong variant view against the options market. Our $268.93 target and 0.63 P(gain) sit close to the options-only distribution (target $263.75, P(gain) 0.61, 15th percentile $173.36). Against the sell side we are more cautious: the 50-analyst median target is $315 (range $210-515, Strong Buy), ~17% above ours. The gap is the multiple, not EPS: we assume 16x on Oct-2027 NTM EPS because FY29 growth should slow to low-to-mid teens. Our customer-capex work adds a second gap. At base capture, base-case 2027 capex implies FY28 revenue of ~$647B, 6% below the $687B consensus, and NVIDIA's supply cap (~$700-750B) limits FY28 upside. So we are below the Street on both multiple and FY28 revenue, and in line with options. [sources 9, 11, 12]

valuation.methods: Supervisor research target (12m) $263 is a blend of two legs. P/E (60%): consistent Oct-2027 NTM EPS (Q3 FY28-Q2 FY29) of $17.1 = H2 FY28 consensus $8.90 + H1 FY29 ~$8.5 (FY29 +13-15%, ~2% memory-cost haircut), x 16x = $274. FCF yield (40%): $17.1 x 23.9B shares x 72% conversion = $12.3/share at a 5.0% yield = $246, + ~$1 net cash = $247. Agent research targets (12m) $250/$255/$260/$270/$296 (median $260). agent_4 is high on 17x and a 4.5% yield. 16x is ~22% below the AVGO/TSM 20.57x anchor. The published target $268.93 is the median of the blended options-plus-agents distribution. Thesis break $160.

risks.risk: 2027-28 hyperscaler capex digestion that cuts FY29 EPS. This is the bear case (~$145-165, 25-28% probability) and hits AVGO, GOOGL and VST in the book at the same time.
risks.signpost: Late-October 2027 guides below the ~$935B consensus, flat 2028 commentary, or capex funded increasingly by debt as hyperscaler FCF turns negative.

risks.risk: ASIC share gains (TPU, Trainium, MTIA, OpenAI-Broadcom; Anthropic's multi-GW TPU from 2027) compress NVIDIA's capture of hyperscaler spend.
risks.signpost: Broadcom FY27 XPU outlook above trend (XPU already 73% of its $16.7B AI revenue); NVDA Hyperscale share of Data Center falling. A 2.5pt capture shift is worth ~±$33B of FY28 revenue.

risks.risk: Earnings quality and vendor financing: DSO rose to 60 days from 45 on extended terms; $105B lease-guarantee cap and $25B of equity commitments to AI customers.
risks.signpost: DSO above 60 or FCF conversion below ~50% of net income again in Q3 FY27; new guarantees or customer-financing disclosures in the 10-Q.

risks.risk: Margin squeeze from HBM/memory costs, combined with a hiking Fed that compresses the multiple.
risks.signpost: Q4 FY27 GM guide below the 71-72% trough or FY28 below 72-73%; a December hike with hawkish 2027 dots.

trade.position: 1 sh held, bought 2026-10-05 @ $237.25 (+$6 fee, cost basis $243.25, ~2.4% of the ~$9,976 book); up to 2 sh after Q3 FY27
trade.entry: Staged in two tranches. Tranche 1 (1 sh) is done. Tranche 2 (+1 sh, to 2 sh total, ~4.8% of the book, under the supervisor's 5% cap) comes after the ~Nov 17-18 Q3 FY27 results, and only if (a) the Oct 27-30 hyperscaler 2027 capex guides come in at or above the base case in adhoc/nvda_customer_capex.md (Big-4 2027 ~$1,080B), (b) the Q3 print keeps the Q4 guide and the FY28 ~+70% framework intact, and (c) price stays above the $174.61 stop.
trade.exit_or_add: Exit on a close below the stop. The stop is $174.61 (15th percentile). Also exit, whatever the price, if Big-4 2027 guides come in below the ~$935B consensus or the Q4 guide breaks the FY28 ~+70% / 71-72% GM framework. Thesis break is $160. Take profit at $337.15. Trim above ~$303 per the decider ladder. Add to 2 sh only on the conditions above. Without a fresh catalyst the decider's add levels are ~$215 (+1 sh) and ~$205 (to 2 sh above base), each after a news check.

what_changes_our_mind: Big-4 2027 capex guides on Oct 27-30 sum below the ~$935B consensus, or any of the four guides 2027 flat. That breaks the base case and moves us toward exiting rather than adding.
Q3 FY27 (~Nov 17-18): a Q4 guide or commentary implying FY28 growth well below ~+70%, a GM trough below 71%, or DSO above 60 days with FCF conversion still under ~50%.

Upside case: 2027 guides at or above our $1,360B high case together with a FY28 outlook of at least +75%. That would justify the full 3 sh and moving the target toward agent_4's $296 research target (12m).
